title_english: Why so much hatred for Revered Premanandji Maharaj? You will be surprised to know the truth.

title_english: When the tongue sticks to the palate and starts to become moist.Then nectar starts flowing.

title_english: What can be taken away from you by chanting the Name? These things are not discussed in satsang.
